_note: Amenities in PIXEL coordinates on ATN's official 2026 site map — same 3000x3000 frame as stage-positions.json, so the same 0.792 m/px scale applies. Read off the image on 2026-07-28 from four independently-cropped tiles. The NUMBERED entries are the map's own 'Experiences' list (24-46) and are complete. The unnumbered facility points (toilets/water/food/medical) are those legible at this resolution and are NOT an exhaustive census — the map draws long rows of identical icons and only the cluster anchors are recorded. Positions are estimates from a picture, not surveyed points.

items.name: Craft Cocktails
items._note2: CONFIRMED 2026-07-29. Position validated against ATN's own bar coordinates (15m). The name was briefly in doubt because ATN's POI at this spot is labelled 'Ping Pong Bar' — but the operator identified the C as the Craft Cocktails brand logo, and they are a known operator, so the marker is theirs. That makes ATN's 'Ping Pong Bar' POI their SECOND confirmed misplacement of the evening, after the Circle marker landing on the Jameson logo: their POI layer was unreliable while being populated, and the published raster plus the operator's on-the-ground brand knowledge beat it both times.
items._note: CORRECTED 2026-07-29. Was [2120,1912] — a placeholder copied from #36 Arcadia Bar when the original map read couldn't find a marker numbered 34. ATN's map has NO 34: it labels two markers '35. BAR', one at Ping Pong Disco and one in The Folly. The operator identified the Folly marker's multicoloured C logo as Craft Cocktails, so that one is the mislabelled 34 (#35 = 'Ping Pong Bar' fits the other). Position derived by georeferencing: Folly marker at composite px (4511,5417) -> 52.289901,-7.361522 via the overlay-tile bounds, then into this frame through a least-squares fit over 15 stage control points (worst residual 29px ~ 23m). Lands between the Bandstand and Theatre of Food, north of Lawns of Tranquility, matching the map.
